An archive of lab work behind the [projects](projects.qmd). These are course
assignments rather than independent projects, kept here for reference.

## E155: Microprocessor Systems

*Harvey Mudd College · Fall 2025*

A lab sequence on the iCE40 UltraPlus FPGA (SystemVerilog) and the STM32L432KC
microcontroller (C), covering combinational and sequential logic, FSMs,
clock-domain crossing, timers, interrupts, SPI/UART, and FPGA–MCU co-design.
Source on [GitHub](https://github.com/Swayngee/E155-Digital-design-Projects-).

| Lab | Topic | Platform |
|:--|:--|:--|
| [Lab 1](labs/lab1.qmd) | FPGA & MCU familiarization, 7-segment display | FPGA |
| [Lab 2](labs/lab2.qmd) | Time-multiplexed dual 7-segment display | FPGA |
| [Lab 3](labs/lab3.qmd) | Keypad scanner FSM | FPGA |
| [Lab 4](labs/lab4.qmd) | Digital audio with timers and PWM | MCU |
| [Lab 5](labs/lab5.qmd) | Quadrature-encoder motor speed with interrupts | MCU |
| [Lab 6](labs/lab6.qmd) | IoT temperature web server over SPI & UART | MCU |
| Lab 7 | AES-128 encryption accelerator → [full writeup](projects/aes-accelerator.qmd) | FPGA + MCU |

The course final project became the
[real-time 3-band audio equalizer](projects/audio-eq.qmd).

Course references: [class website](https://hmc-e155.github.io/),
[dev board BOM](https://hmc-e155.github.io/assets/doc/E155_v4_Dev_Board_BOM.html),
[STM32L4 reference manual](https://hmc-e155.github.io/assets/doc/rm0394-stm32l41xxx42xxx43xxx44xxx45xxx46xxx-advanced-armbased-32bit-mcus-stmicroelectronics.pdf),
[iCE40 UltraPlus datasheet](https://hmc-e155.github.io/assets/doc/FPGA-DS-02008-2-0-iCE40-UltraPlus-Family-Data-Sheet.pdf).

## E157: RF Circuit Design

*Prof. Devon Donahue · Harvey Mudd College · Fall 2026*

Transmission-line behavior, network-analyzer measurement, Smith charts, matching
networks, and filter design. Every design is analyzed by hand, simulated in
LTspice, then built and measured.

| Work | Topic |
|:--|:--|
| [Transmission Lines and Reflections](rf/transmission-lines.qmd) | Step response, standing waves, TDR |
| [L-Matching Network and VNA Characterization](rf/lmatch.qmd) | SOL calibration, Smith charts, 270 Ω → 50 Ω match |
| [5th-Order Butterworth Low-Pass Filter](rf/designproject1.qmd) | Design project: 100 MHz LPF, built and measured |
